user.title: Enable Banking application
user.description: Create an application in the [Enable Banking control panel]({control_panel_url}) (Production, restricted mode is free for your own accounts). Register the same redirect URL there, then link your accounts in the control panel.

data_description.private_key: Paste the full content of the .pem file generated when creating the application.
data_description.redirect_url: Must exactly match a redirect URL registered on the application.

authorize.title: Authorize access
authorize.description:
1. Open [this link to {bank}]({auth_url}) and log in to approve access.
2. You will be redirected to a page (it may show an error, that's expected).
3. Copy the **full URL** from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew bank access
reauth_confirm.description: Access to your {bank} accounts expires (or expired) on {valid_until}. Submit to get a new authorization link and approve access at your bank again. Your sensors and history are kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {bank}
reconfigure.description: Update your Enable Banking application details. Your sensors and history are kept.

data_description.private_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.
data_description.redirect_url: Must exactly match a redirect URL registered on the application.
data_description.reauthorize: Required if you changed application. Also refreshes the list of accounts, e.g. to add an account that was missing.

error.invalid_auth: Enable Banking rejected the application ID or private key.
error.no_banks: No banks available for this country.
error.auth_start_failed: Could not start the authorization with this bank. Check that the redirect URL is registered on the application.
error.bank_denied: The bank returned an error or access was refused.
error.no_code: No authorization code found in the URL. Paste the full URL you were redirected to.
error.state_mismatch: This URL belongs to another authorization attempt. Use the link above again.
error.session_failed: Could not create the bank session. The code may have expired, try again.

abort.no_accounts: The bank did not return any account that can be read. Savings accounts (e.g. livrets) are often not available through open banking.
abort.wrong_accounts: The authorized accounts don't match this entry. Log in with the same bank customer as before.
abort.bank_not_found: This bank is no longer available on Enable Banking.

create_entry.skipped_accounts:
Your bank returned these accounts but does not allow reading them, so they were not added:
{accounts}
